Delivery guide

Releases versus packages

Short version: Artifacts are for diagnosis, releases are for end users, and packages are for developer installation. Their lifetimes and owners differ.

Choose by audience

  • Artifact: logs, screenshots, and short-lived test evidence.
  • Release: versioned installers, binaries, and signed archives.
  • Package: libraries, modules, or containers consumed by automation.

Common mistake

Do not enable a publish workflow in a repository that does not actually build the package. A red job is still a minute-consuming job.
